The New India Assurance Company Ltd. ………Appellant
Vs.
Sri Naseem and others ………Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. P.C. Maulekhi, learned counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. Bhuwan Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
respondents-claimants.
3. Mr. Ashutosh Thakral, learned counsel has 
instructions to appear on behalf of owner-Sanjay Tyagi.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the appellant 
that several steps have been taken upon respondent no.3-
Smt. Rita Sareen, w/o Sri Anil Sareen, Vehicle No.UP-14AK￾9444, but still she has not been served.
5. Since the appeal is of the year 2012 the alleged 
accident happened on 30.11.2010.
6. In such view of the matter, Insurance Company is 
directed to take steps upon respondent no.3-Smt. Rita 
Sareen, w/o Sri Anil Sareen, owner of Tavera Jeep Vehicle 
No.UP-14AK-9444 by publication in two daily newspapers 
having wide circulation in District-Gaziabad.
7. Steps to be taken within three weeks.
8. List this case on 03.11.2026. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.09.2026
